correctness.rationale: Writing deleted D as union of three disjoint-off-zero subspaces, the 2-cycle translation x↔x+v partitions helper columns into mutually disjoint pairs and gives a(v)=2^(k-1)-|D|+|D∩(v+D)|/2. For v outside D, any deleted representation uses one element from each of two different Ui, hence exactly one per pair if v∈Ui+Uj. The pair-sum tests in a normal form depend on three independent tail blocks of dimension t. Count their zero/nonzero patterns, subtract D contributions, and recover all four stated N_j; the counts sum to |S|. The normal form works also when three subspaces fail to be direct. Independently enumerated surviving columns, pair sums and full histogram in 12 distinct (k,u,rho) normal-form configurations, including both [22,5,10] examples. General proof is algebraic, not an extrapolation.
